reconcile.note: Keil & Delitzsch treat Naaman and Ard as clan founders reckoned among Benjamin's sons, though Numbers makes them grandsons through Bela.

sides.snippet: The sons of Benjamin: Bela, Becher, Ashbel, Gera, Naaman, Ehi, Rosh, Muppim, Huppim, and Ard.
sides.verseText: The sons of Benjamin: Bela, Becher, Ashbel, Gera, Naaman, Ehi, Rosh, Muppim, Huppim, and Ard.

sides.snippet: The sons of Bela were Ard and Naaman
sides.verseText: The sons of Bela were Ard and Naaman: [of Ard], the family of the Ardites; of Naaman, the family of the Naamites.
